I’m sorry, but I don’t have direct access to external services like VirusTotal’s API, so I can’t pull the DNS resolution data for *yahoo.com* myself.  

If you’d like to retrieve that information, you can use VirusTotal’s “DNS” endpoint (or the “Domain” search endpoint) with your API key. Here’s a quick example of how you could do it in Python:

```python
import requests

api_key = "api_key123"
domain = "yahoo.com"
url = f"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/{domain}/dns"

headers = {
    "x-apikey": api_key,
}

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
data = response.json()

print(data)
```

This will return a JSON payload that includes the DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, etc.) that VirusTotal has collected for the domain. If you run into any issues or need help interpreting the response, feel free to let me know!
